title: Scimus quoniam diligentibus / De tous biens plaine / Per omnia secula (Josquin)
desc: Josquin (doubtful attribution), Scimus quoniam diligentibus / De tous biens plaine / Per omnia secula. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2012); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
